insights.claim: Microplastics in wastewater may concentrate antibiotic-resistance genes relative to the surrounding water phase.
Differences between plastic and sand biofilm communities may explain why resistance genes are enriched on plastic.
qPCR of a few resistance genes may not support resistome claims; metagenomics is needed, requiring a collaborator.

adjacent_ideas.claim: Resistance gene enrichment may vary across polymer types if surface properties shape biofilm colonization.
Resistance genes on plastic biofilms may sit disproportionately on mobile elements, raising downstream horizontal transfer risk.
